description: This is a test class for the UserRoleManagerHelper in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing authorization-related functionalities such as permissions and self-identification based on employee numbers.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the UserRoleManagerHelper functionalities related to authorization and permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithoutAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for an employee without an assigned employee record.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for an employee with an assigned employee record.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForSelfPermission
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for the same employee (self-permission scenario).

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForNotSelfPermission
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when the current user is not acting on their own data.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a permission collection for an employee.

methods.name: testIsSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests whether the helper correctly identifies if the user is acting on their own employee record based on employee number.

methods.name: getIsSelfByEmpNumberDataProvider
methods.description: Data provider for the isSelfByEmpNumber test, providing various user and employee number scenarios.
